name: Storm Wyvern
fantasy: A rearing two-legged dragon whose wings are its forelimbs, with lightning veined through the membranes. Strikes with its wing claws, bites, and whips its barbed tail round.

directions.name: Sky
directions.desc: Dives, gales and the storm overhead: never where they strike.

skills.name: Storm Arc
skills.desc: The wyvern rears up, the lightning in its wings flaring, and breathes a bolt into the nearest foe ahead that leaps on to four more nearby, striking each.

skills.name: Thunder Dive
skills.desc: Climb on your wings and dive onto the pointer (12 metres) in a strike of lightning: 240% weapon damage within 4 metres, stunning them for 0.8 seconds.

skills.name: Thunderhead
skills.desc: Roar up a storm cloud over the pointer for 4 seconds: every half second it strikes a foe beneath it (within 5 metres) for 45% weapon damage. At most two at once.

skills.name: Gale Wings
skills.desc: One great beat of your wings: everything in a cone 6.5 metres ahead takes 100% weapon damage, is hurled back and slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

rites.name: Tempest
rites.text: Critical hits call lightning down: {pct}% weapon damage within {r} m.

rites.name: Rending Claws
rites.text: Claws and bites deal +{dmg:attack}%; +{crit}% critical chance.

rites.name: Primal Fury
rites.text: Each kill: +{dmg}% damage for {secs} seconds, up to {stacks} times.

rites.name: Plummet
rites.text: Thunder Dive lands {dive_r}% wider, {dmg:v_dive}% harder and comes back {cd:v_dive}% sooner.

rites.name: Supercell
rites.text: Thunderhead strikes {cloud_rate}% faster, lasts {cloud_t} s longer, and each bolt has a {cloud_stun}% chance to stun.

rites.name: Hurricane
rites.text: Gale Wings reaches {gale_r}% further and hits {dmg:v_gale}% harder.

rites.name: Wind-Rider
rites.text: +{dex} Dexterity; Thunder Dive and Gale Wings +{dmg:v_dive}%.

rites.name: Hunter's Updraft
rites.text: Each kill: +{frw}% run speed for {secs} seconds.

rites.name: Eye of the Storm
rites.text: A kill with Thunder Dive makes it ready again.

rites.name: Static Claws
rites.text: Claws leap on as lightning to {jumps} more foes ({pct}%).
